self_audit: Read prd.md in full (521 lines) and addendum.md; checked against SPEC.md, rendering-rules.md, adapter-contract.md, acceptance-tests.md, owner-decisions-and-risks.md, stack.md, write-back-future-stage.md, release-gates.md, snapshot-export-schema.md, issue-409-body.md and owner-decisions-20261108.md. Checked by machine that every T1-T51 appears in prd.md (addendum:46 holds). Checked that `orca orchestration reply` (prd.md:259) comes from write-back-future-stage.md:38, so it is not an invented command. Checked that the stack citations (prd.md:132, :464) follow the spec's 'recorded owner decision N' label convention (owner-decisions-and-risks.md:3), so they are not defects. Did not flag owner-bound decisions or open OQ/UX-OQ items.

findings.finding: The earlier fix holds. The FR-8 mismatch string matches the spec character for character.
findings.evidence: PRD: "renders `collected n / reported T (mismatch)`". Spec: "Finished traversal with n not T: `collected n / reported T (mismatch)`."

findings.finding: The earlier fix holds. The glossary PARTIAL definition keeps the meaning of adapter-contract.md:15 (cap stops the cursor walk). The added empty-page clause is sourced from adapter-contract.md:49 and rendering-rules.md:55.
findings.evidence: PRD: "paging stopped at the per-cycle call cap while `page.hasMore` was still true". Spec: "a guard that marks the view PARTIAL when the per-cycle cap stops it."

findings.finding: The PRD says owner-decisions-20261108.md decisions 4 and 5 are open. Item 5 in that file is the CONFIRMED stack decision; the open items are summary.md decisions 4 and 5. The PRD's own OI-11 (prd.md:451) says item 5 confirms the stack, so the PRD contradicts itself.
findings.evidence: PRD:457 "Owner positions still open (owner-decisions-20261108.md decisions 4 and 5)". Source item 5: "Stack and release-1 scope CONFIRMED ... the licence opinion (decision 4), TUIBBS as the staff platform (decision 5)" (summary.md numbering).
findings.suggested_fix: Cite "summary.md decisions 4 and 5, as listed in owner-decisions-20261108.md item 5" instead of owner-decisions-20261108.md decisions 4 and 5.

findings.finding: FR-8 says T47 pins the worker-list traversal mismatch string. T47 covers only the question area before QUESTION-OBSERVATION. No CAP-4 test (SPEC.md:42) pins the worker-list mismatch, so the PRD claims test coverage that does not exist.
findings.evidence: PRD: "`collected n / reported T (mismatch)` (rendering-rules.md), pinned by T47". T47: "Before QUESTION-OBSERVATION the question area reads ... mismatch ... notes render".
findings.suggested_fix: Drop "pinned by T47" for the worker-list mismatch, mark it "No spec test", and add it to OI-6.

findings.finding: Issue AC 7 (filtered versus global counts explicit, I:83) is mapped to FR-8, but no FR states the spec's filter rule. The `/` filter exists (NFR-5), yet nothing requires the `filter <expr>: k of n collected` disclosure or the footer `shown x/y` form.
findings.evidence: Spec: "a filter always shows `filter <expr>: k of n collected` beside the unfiltered `source counts: ...`". PRD:331 maps AC 7 to "NFR-6, FR-8"; FR-8 has no filter consequence.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an FR-8 or FR-10 consequence carrying rendering-rules.md:56 and the footer `shown x/y | collected n / reported T` (rendering-rules.md:21), marked no spec test.

findings.finding: An R1 requirement (FR-8, CAP-4, R1) carries post-gate R2 question-area behaviour (rotation token, empty rotation set). This blurs the staged release boundary that the owner decision binds.
findings.evidence: PRD: "After QUESTION-OBSERVATION the question area also shows `collected n unique / reported T` ... a per-scope `revisit ~Ns` rotation token".
findings.suggested_fix: Move the post-gate question-area consequences to FR-17 (R2).

findings.finding: The addendum traces FR-6 and T45 to CAP-2, but CAP-2's success list does not name T45, and no CAP success line cites T45. The trace is invented by the PRD and is not labelled as such.
findings.evidence: CAP-2 success: "(T9, T20-T22, T32, T39)". Addendum: "CAP-2 Worker ledger | R1 | FR-3, FR-4, FR-5, FR-6 | ... T39, T45".
findings.suggested_fix: Label the FR-6/T45 trace `[ASSUMPTION]`, or trace it to CAP-4 scope honesty (adapter-contract.md:63).

findings.finding: FR-14 and UJ-2 (prd.md:66) star only changed rows. The spec also stars rows added or removed since the mark, so the PRD narrows the change rule.
findings.evidence: Spec: "Every row added, removed or changed in `stage` ... `nextAction.kind` or `liveness.verdict` since the mark shows `*`". PRD UJ-2: "rows whose stage, `nextAction.kind` or `liveness.verdict` changed are starred".
findings.suggested_fix: Add "added or removed" to FR-14 and UJ-2.

findings.finding: FR-8 gives only the short PARTIAL form. The pinned spec string carries the INV-007 disclosure, which the PRD keeps only in risk table K10 (prd.md:369), not in any FR.
findings.evidence: Spec: "`PARTIAL: collected n of reported T (newest first; oldest rows not read; long-running active workers may be among them)`". PRD: "`PARTIAL: collected 500 of reported T` (T4)".
findings.suggested_fix: Quote the full pinned PARTIAL string in FR-8, keeping T4 as the test for its prefix.

findings.finding: The worker-list paging integrity forms are missing from the FRs: `reported T (page k)` and `reported T1-T2 (changed during read)`. The PRD has `changed during read` only for the post-gate question area.
findings.evidence: Spec: "`page.total` changing between pages: `reported T1-T2 (changed during read)`"; rendering-rules.md:55 "T comes from the last page read: `reported T (page k)`".
findings.suggested_fix: Add both worker-list paging forms to FR-8.

findings.finding: The FR-8 scope consequence leaves out the spec's rule that `bound` scope adds `one Run only`. It appears only in risk K4 (prd.md:363), so no requirement makes it testable.
findings.evidence: Spec: "absent reads `scope unknown`; `bound` adds `one Run only`". PRD: "The header shows `scope=<result.scope.source>` or `scope unknown`".
findings.suggested_fix: Add "`bound` adds `one Run only`" to the FR-8 scope consequence.

findings.finding: FR-9 covers timeout failure only. The parse-failure form `FAILED (shape)` and the rule that the last good snapshot is kept, qualified `as of`, appear nowhere in the PRD.
findings.evidence: Spec: "Any missing: the cycle is `FAILED (shape)` and the last good snapshot is kept." Also adapter-contract.md:50 "the last good snapshot stays, qualified `as of`".
findings.suggested_fix: Add a FR-9 consequence for `FAILED (shape)` / invalid JSON keeping the last good snapshot with `as of`.

findings.finding: Several requirements cite step-1 review items that no listed artifact defines, so a reader cannot trace them. The same applies at prd.md:214, :237, :261 and :442.
findings.evidence: "(step-1 coverage gaps G1-G3, G5-G7)"; "(step-1 minor 3)"; "(Step-1 minors 3, 4 and 5.)"
findings.suggested_fix: Replace step-1 references with the spec file:line or OI id they stand for, or name the step-1 review file path.

findings.finding: FR-7 puts the live empty-worker string under T33, but T33 tests only the fixture `empty` variant. The live `worker-list returned 0 workers in scope=bound` string has no test, and the PRD does not say so.
findings.evidence: T33: "`empty` renders `no observed items in this source window; not proof none exist`, never `no questions`."
findings.suggested_fix: Mark the live empty-worker string "No spec test" in FR-7.
